title: Ross Coulthart says on Need to Know that the Tic Tac is Lockheed Martin technology
summary: Bryce Zabel tells of Ross Coulthart says on Need to Know that the Tic Tac is Lockheed Martin technology, about c. 2025 at Need to Know show, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: looks, he goes, "Bryce, I can now state," this is the quote, "I can now state categorically that the tic tac is Loheed Martin technology."
I'm going to leave you with one thought today, Bryce. I now know categorically that the tic tac is Loheed Martin technology.
tellings.difference: Told by Coulthart himself in the clip, using 'I now know' rather than 'I can now state'.
tellings.link_reason: The clip of the same Coulthart statement to Bryce on Need to Know that telling 7 describes.

plain: A writer and producer, Bryce Zabel, says that around 2025 on a show they did together called Need to Know, a journalist named Ross Coulthart told him he could now state categorically that the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint that Navy pilots reported, is technology made by Lockheed Martin, a big American aerospace and weapons company. A clip of Coulthart has him saying it slightly differently: that he now knows it categorically. If true, it would mean the famous object was a human-built craft, not something from elsewhere.
